label: MiniMax H3 VFX Edit
description: MiniMax H3 + Alissonerdx's VFX Edit LoRAs: the same take back with only the prompted change (add, remove, replace), following the plate's motion and camera. Optional 'first_frame': an already edited first frame that the edit should carry through the shot. Output: EXRs at plate size, no audio.
usage: Edits a shot: the same take back with only the prompted change (add, remove, replace).
Start the prompt with 'vfx_edit:' - one sentence: the edit, then what must stay the same.
Whole input range is sent; tick 'input range' to send only first-last.
Optional 'first_frame': a frame you already fixed; name it <Picture 1> in the prompt and the edit is carried through the shot (use an FFP LoRA).
Comp the result back only where the edit is.
Press Render in ComfyUI; Bring in output reads the result under the node.

highlights: 'roll off' (default) compresses values above 1 going in: highlights return approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed and new near-whites come back hot. 'clip' cuts at 1 and keeps shadows open.

License (checked 2026-11): MiniMax H3 Community - not authorized in the US, EU, UK or South Korea, outputs included. Commercial use is free under $20M a year; above that needs MiniMax's written authorization. Outputs can't be used to improve other AI models. The LoRAs' own licenses are unconfirmed.

output.tooltip: H3 makes a display-referred (sRGB) clip at its work size; it is scaled back to plate size. Comp it back only where the edit is.

knobs.name: prompt
knobs.label: prompt
knobs.tooltip: Start with 'vfx_edit:'. One English sentence: the edit, then what must stay unchanged, e.g. 'vfx_edit: Add fire to the man's hands while preserving his identity, pose, motion, clothing, framing, lighting and background.' Don't ask to preserve the area being replaced. With 'first_frame' connected, name it as <Picture 1> and say what it is.

knobs.name: lora
knobs.label: LoRA
knobs.tooltip: Standard: prompt-only edits (trained 384 px, 73 frames). FFP: trained further at 512 px / 124 frames and can carry an edited first frame through the shot. FFP + SolarRenderer: the FFP LoRA merged with SolarRenderer control at 0.5 (the author's newest first-frame version).

knobs.name: megapixels
knobs.label: megapixels
knobs.tooltip: Size H3 works at, with the plate's aspect (multiple of 32); scaled back to plate size after. 0.7 = the author's default. The LoRAs were trained at 384-512 px.

knobs.name: highlights
knobs.label: highlights
knobs.tooltip: roll off (default): the plate and refs go in through ACES Output - sRGB and the result comes back through its inverse, so highlights are compressed instead of cut. Highlights come back approximate, saturated colours shift, deep shadows are crushed, and new near-white pixels come back hot (display 0.98 = about 7, 1.0 = about 16). clip: values above 1 reach the model as 1 (colorimetric), shadows stay open. Comp only the changed area.
